podcast.title: Bohemian Soho Figure
podcast.body: Lionel Bart was at the center of a bohemian crowd in Soho, living in a squat that also housed other notable artists like Jim Antrobus, Shirley Eaton, and David Graham. "Bart was at the centre of a bohemian crowd in Soho, and the party was held at a squat where Bart, a card-carrying member of the Communist party, spent most of his time."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Early Songwriting Collaboration
podcast.body: Bart collaborated with Thomas Hicks and Mike Pratt on songs, with Hicks providing basic ideas, Bart writing lyrics, and Pratt composing the music. "Hicks, Bart and Pratt started collaborating on songs together."
